records.subject: Charge-balanced A1 iron indium thiospinel series (y = z)
records.quote: A detailed study was focused on two distinct series (y=z): 1) a previously reported charge-balanced (In0.67+0.33y;(0.33-0.33y))(tetr)[In2-zFez](oct)S-4 (A1-series; ; stands for vacancy; the abbreviations tetr and oct indicate atoms occupying tetrahedral 8a and octahedral 16d sites, respectively) and 2) a new charge-unbalanced (In0.67+y;(0.33-y))(tetr)[In2-zFez](oct)S-4 (A2-series).
